one_line: DeepSeek raises $15 billion, Mistral unveils new models, AI agents expand into retail and finance, research benchmarks advance.

themes.title: DeepSeek secures $15 billion funding
themes.text: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek secured roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after U.S. agencies were ordered to remove its technology.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: Mistral launches large multimodal model and voice SDK
themes.text: Mistral AI released a preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters, and announced the Voxtral 3 family of speech‑to‑text and text‑to‑speech models with a real‑time voice‑agent SDK supporting over 50 languages.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models

themes.title: AI agents enter retail and banking services
themes.text: Walmart will let third‑party AI agents shop for customers via an Agent Gateway, Karta AI raised $3 million to automate complex inbound banking calls in 25 languages, and Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent for professionals, in a research preview.

stories.headline: Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview

themes.title: Research benchmarks evaluate frontier AI models
themes.text: Researchers benchmarked six frontier AI models on the LIBERO‑10 robot manipulation suite, introduced the PAPAV framework for multimodal embodied agents, created the Environment Duels benchmark to study LLM co‑evolution, and Microsoft researchers proved the 31‑year‑old KLS conjecture using a human‑directed AI process.

stories.headline: Frontier AI models evaluated on LIBERO-10 robot tasks, GPT‑6 Astra tops at 44% success
Paper proposes PAPAV framework to unify multimodal agents and robots
Environment Duels benchmark studies LLM co‑evolution through author‑solver interactions
Microsoft researchers prove 31-year-old KLS conjecture in high-dimensional geometry
